headSubject: [story-052] Wire StableStaker into global Pauser (Phase 8) + config audit
intentComment: Story 003 — local Anvil dev orchestration: clean state, start anvil, deploy the full Phase-2 mock stack (DeployMocks), simulate yield, extract addresses, generate TS bindings, serve via API. NOT a mainnet/broadcast path — chainId 31337 only.

dev.command: npm run clean:local && npm run start:anvil & sleep 3 && npm run deploy:local && ./simulate-yield.sh && npm run extract:addresses && npm run generate:ts-anvil && npm run serve
dev.note: The forge target broadcasts to a LOCAL anvil node (http://localhost:8545, chainId 31337) using ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY (publicly-known default key). No mainnet exposure.

chainSteps.note: Deletes prior local broadcast artifacts + progress/local state files. Backgrounded together with start:anvil via the single '&'.
Backgrounded ('&' after clean:local). 'sleep 3' gives anvil time to bind before deploy:local runs.

chainSteps.command: npm run clean:local && forge script script/DeployMocks.s.sol:DeployMocks --rpc-url http://localhost:8545 --broadcast --slow
chainSteps.note: PRIMARY FOCUS. Re-runs clean:local then broadcasts DeployMocks. This is the contract-deploy + wiring step the audit centers on.
Auxiliary. Reads progress.31337.json, mints DOLA directly into MockAutoDOLA to fake yield. Not deep-mapped per user instruction.
Auxiliary off-chain. Reads broadcast/out artifacts, writes server/deployments/local.json + addresses.
Auxiliary. Long-running Express API on :3001 serving deployment JSON. Not deep-mapped.

forgeTarget.chainGuard: none — DeployMocks only console.log's block.chainid; no require(block.chainid == N). Safe only because the dev chain always targets local anvil:8545.
